_meta.source: Department of Health, Ministry of Public Health, Thailand
_meta.citation: Department of Health, Ministry of Public Health, Thailand. One-dish food nutrient survey (โครงการปริมาณสารอาหารในอาหารจานเดียว), Tables 1–2. Values are per reference serving; FoodCal scales them to the user-entered gram amount.
_meta.note: Only classes with a direct or clearly related prepared-dish record are mapped. Approximate mappings are shown as such in the UI. Other THFOOD-50 classes remain without nutrition rather than receiving an unsupported estimate.

thai_wonton_soup.name: เกี๊ยวน้ำ
